title: Everyone talks about ai trading, no one talks about the issues that come with it
author: Nvestiq
selftext:
It's no surprise LLMs hallucinate. Maybe it tries to falsely predict outcomes that never existed, or maybe there was an invisible character in your code that you wouldn't catch until it deploys live.

Now let me tell you the new gold standard. Being able to create your strategy, whether that's from scratch or optimizing your current strategy (w/o code, of course). 

Then being able to validate that strategy at an architectural level, eliminating outcomes like walk-forward bias, hallucinogenic code, etc. Then exporting your automation to your preferred broker. That's what we have built at Nvestiq. We've deployed our beta to a few hundred users, got their feedback, and now it's getting closer to the time to publicly launch. Cheers!

[https://nvestiq.com/](https://nvestiq.com/)
